notes: §1985:VIII.4.6.2 prints the relative REWRITE as REWRITE record-name-1 [ FROM identifier-1 ] [ INVALID KEY ... ] [ NOT INVALID KEY ... ] [ END-REWRITE ], and §1985:IV.2.1 makes that arrangement the format ('A general format is the specific arrangement of the elements of a clause or a statement'). The superset rule rewriteStatement parses it, SequentialIoBinder.BindRewrite routes a relative file to KeyedIoBinder.BindRewrite, and at --std 85 the later additions are refused on recognition (probed): FROM literal and FROM ZERO (VisitRecordFromPhrase, COBOL0871), FILE file-name (DeclinedFilePhrase, COBOL1706), RETRY (VisitRetryPhrase) and WITH LOCK (VisitRecordLockPhrase) COBOL0900, NOT INVALID KEY before INVALID KEY (VisitConditionalPhrases via OutOfPrintedOrder, COBOL0900, landed PB5158), a doubled INVALID KEY, doubled FROM, empty FROM, missing record-name, a WORKING-STORAGE name and a stray END-REWRITE by the parser or resolver; INVALID KEY under sequential access is COBOL1720. Probes run: (a) an OCCURS DEPENDING ON record rewritten FROM a group (3 [3ABC]) and FROM a ref-modified WN-T(9:1); (d) FROM a function-identifier (Amendment 1) runs; (e) random, dynamic and sequential access run, REWRITE after CLOSE gives status 49 with neither phrase executed; (f) key 0 and 9999 give INVALID KEY with status 23. What is not implemented: the word RECORD after record-name-1 (rewriteStatement is REWRITE (recordName | FILE fileName) RECORD? with no edition arm), so REWRITE REL-REC RECORD INVALID KEY ... compiles and runs at 85; the word is the 2002/2023 format's (§2023:14.9.35.2). The witness runs FROM, both phrases in order and END-REWRITE on a present and an absent key. kb/Work PB5159 holds the defect (code read: coderead-85/out-reread/reread-1.json).

next.reason: 1985: "REWRITE record-name-1 [ FROM identifier-1 ] [ INVALID KEY ... ] [ NOT INVALID KEY ... ]"; 2023: "REWRITE {record-name-1 | FILE file-name-1} [FROM {identifier-1|literal-1}] [retry-phrase] [WITH LOCK|WITH NO LOCK] |INVALID KEY| |NOT INVALID KEY|". 2023 adds FILE file-name-1, FROM literal-1, retry and LOCK phrases. Its choice indicators let INVALID KEY and NOT INVALID KEY appear in either order, so more programs are accepted.
